summary: Implemented an observation-only Binance/Bybit public and Bybit private forward evidence layer with local wall and monotonic receive clocks, raw-payload hashes, append-only record chains, environment-only authentication, execId-authoritative execution reconciliation, exact-capture-prefix Shadow A/B, capture-quality reports and automatic risk-state mapping. The deterministic source bundle passed 16 local tests and compileall. No prospective observations exist yet; no alpha, live promotion or order-placement capability is claimed.
